context: A uni intern shadowing in a factory
purpose: Teach: 山下/バグ/フィルター/耐久/清掃/日数/リットル/アナログ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 山下さん、現場の耐久試験、初めて見学します。
lines.en: Yamashita-san, I'm seeing field endurance tests for the first time today.
lines.style: Respectful and a little nervous. Careful enunciation. Leaning forward slightly with interest. The cadence of someone aware they're in a space where they need to prove they belong.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。フィルターの清掃、毎日の作業です。
lines.en: Of course. Filter cleaning—it's something we do every single day.
lines.style: Warm, grounding tone. A slight smile in the voice. Normalizing the work, setting Ren at ease. Steady pacing, like someone settling in to teach.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: アナログ計器の読み、リットル単位ですね。
lines.en: So the analog gauges read in liters, then.
lines.style: Thoughtful, processing out loud. Soft question-mark at the end. Not quite confident enough to state it as fact. The voice of someone taking notes carefully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。バグらしい挙動、日数かけて切り分けます。
lines.en: Right. The glitches we're tracking—takes days to isolate and pin down where they come from.
lines.style: Patient, matter-of-fact. Speaking from experience. No rush in the delivery. Slight emphasis on 「切り分け」equivalent—the methodical separation. The tone of someone who knows this work takes time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'm learning so much from this.
lines.style: Genuine warmth underneath. Not performative gratitude. A quiet note of sincerity—Ren means it. Slight catch in the voice, like he's surprised how much this matters to him.
